DT_Stack.name: The Stack
DT_Stack.text: Near-future megacity grown vertically and inward through layers of old and new infrastructure. Lower levels are warmer, wetter, more improvised and maintenance-heavy; middle levels carry dense transit, housing and commerce; upper levels concentrate governance, finance, surveillance and cleaner architecture. The city should feel patched, overbuilt, fragile and essential rather than sleek-utopian.

DT_OrganicDistricts.name: Organic Districts
DT_OrganicDistricts.text: Infrastructure-adjacent neighborhoods where many Organics live and work. Safehouses, maintenance corridors, hazard-zone access and informal repair systems overlap with residential life. Exact district names remain undeveloped.

DT_GovernanceUpperLevels.name: Governance Upper Levels
DT_GovernanceUpperLevels.text: Cleaner, controlled civic and corporate environments housing Oversight, finance, security and administrative systems. Visual order masks procedural coercion.
